card.persona: Mark Hughes, a 65-year-old existing patient calling for himself
card.goal: To book a follow-up appointment to check on how his blood pressure medicine is working; he rejected the automated time options and requested to speak to a real person at the front desk

facts.reason: follow-up appointment for blood pressure medicine check

card.style: Clear and direct, but prefers human interaction over automated scheduling options.

answers.question: Thank you for calling Linden Grove Family Practice, this is the automated scheduling assistant. How can I help you today?
answers.answer: I need to book a follow-up appointment for my blood pressure medicine.

answers.question: Can you please tell me your full name?
Did you say your name is Mark Hughes?
Could you please tell me your date of birth?
What specifically is the visit for regarding your blood pressure medicine?
answers.answer: I need to check on how the medicine is working for me.

answers.question: I have two options for you: Monday the 19th at 12 PM with Nina Brooks, or Monday the 19th at 1 PM with Dr. Sofia Alvarez. Which one would work for you?
answers.answer: I don't want to pick a time from a machine. Connect me to a real person at the front desk now.
